description: ask the thinking plugin to create a new Work Breakdown Structure document for a specific phase and return the full created Work Breakdown Structure.
embedding_description: Create work breakdown structure for a specific phase of a work manifest. Initialize a new phase-scoped execution document with numbered work items, steps, and sub-steps. Create phase scaffold linked to parent manifest. Start a new phase execution plan.

result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The Work Breakdown Structure has been created and is now available as working context. Continue executing the current step as shown in the updated ACTIVE_PLAN.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Creating a Work Breakdown Structure document. create_work_breakdown_structure accepts {wbs_id, manifest_id, phase_number, phase_name, directive}. The thinking model generates the full WBS from the directive.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema. StorageError: knowledge base write failed. FileExistsError: a WBS with this ID already exists. ProcessCoverageError: a required process from the topology packet was not found in the assembled work item — retry with a more explicit directive that names the missing process and the work item it belongs to.
